problem: The English pricing route could keep stale partially translated pricing when the composer skipped pages that already contained the pricing marker.
root_cause: The pricing composer treated the presence of data-bg-commercial-pricing-v1 as proof that the current locale output was already canonical, so EN could retain an earlier transformed page.
decision: Always replace the pricing page main content from the canonical locale renderer on every build for both NL and EN.
prevention: Pricing generation must be idempotent and locale-authoritative.
Presence of a prior pricing marker is never sufficient to skip locale regeneration.
